head: 82e45812d480454a26f1e7c3fc016e49d687834f
status: closed source assessment; no prototype or timing
facts: ExecutableSlot already has one reference/one long; do not introduce a wider generic tagged value.
YieldValue/TakeYieldValue already use ExecutableSlot and PyIterationResult; no generator transport rewrite is established.
Synchronous generator Advance already calls frame.Execute directly, without async advancement.
ExecuteInstructionPrefix already loops across completed instructions; it is not a per-op driver call.
String Join/JoinAsync drain through MaterializeLeased into List<object>, validate after complete consumption, then write exact final UTF8.
Ordinary split returns a PyList; cased whitespace uses an existing private native range carrier.
investigation: Assess one complete UTF8 range transport path across private split iteration, existing slots/yield and final string consumers. Require concrete removed storage/work before implementation; no identity ledger, scalar coupons, new memory subsystem or mere extra wrapper.
priorLessons: R440 streaming casing/bulk refinement reduced allocation but lost CPU
R445 one generator-expression engine is delivered
R450 native/CLR cursor consolidation is delivered
R456 managed code generation lost whole-script CPU and increased compilation cost
decision: Existing split fragments already share admitted source backing. Removing remaining shells across mutable slot copies and published collection aliases requires canonical publication/ownership machinery or a narrow fused recipe; neither justified. Preserve current representation; no permanent ban.
